values: Shall the Town of Nottingham adopt a Temporary Moratorium on Data Centers Ordinance pursuant to RSA 674:23, which would prohibit the acceptance, processing, approval, or issuance of permits or approvals for the establishment, construction, expansion, or operation of data centers within the Town for a period of twelve (12) months, to allow the Town time to study potential impacts and develop appropriate zoning regulations?
